name: WirelessHART
description: Wireless field instrumentation communications for process automation; mesh networking adds redundant routes in difficult radio environments of process facilities. Applicable offshore and onshore. Primary source: https://www.fieldcommgroup.org/technologies/wirelesshart

specifications.basis: FieldComm Group WirelessHART technology page, descriptive claim
specifications.value: Each device can act as a router; redundant communication routes extend range and improve reliability

specifications.metric: installation cost reduction vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: FieldComm Group WirelessHART page citing WirelessHART User Case Studies: '30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments'
HART Protocol Specifications: 2.4GHz DSSS O-QPSK Physical Layer Specification (HCF_SPEC-65 FCG TS20065) Rev. 1.1
specifications.value: 2.4 GHz DSSS O-QPSK, based on IEEE STD 802.15.4-2006 2.4GHz DSSS Physical Layer

specifications.basis: HCF_SPEC-75 FCG TS20075 Rev. 1.2 (TDMA Data-Link Layer)
specifications.value: TDMA Data-Link Layer over IEEE 802.15.4-2006 PHY; secure, reliable, error-free mesh communication
one-way publishing, exception notification, ad-hoc request/response, auto-segmented block transfers

applications: Wireless field instrumentation communications for process automation; mesh networking adds redundant routes in difficult radio environments of process facilitie
